rules:
I'll be taking a break from regular puzzle setting for a while. A huge thank you to everyone who has been solving my puzzles and for all your kindness and support! It really means a lot. See you around! :)

Link to SudokuPad: https://sudokupad.app/txwbsf70o7

Rules: Normal 6×6 sudoku rules apply. An arrow outside a row or column numbered N indicates that the digits in some initial run of cells, starting from the arrow, sum to N+1.

Note: Rows and columns are numbered from top to bottom and left to right, respectively.
